modelling_note: Synthetic toy method sketch of primary-commitment / fail-closed dispatch. Supplied typed proposals replace the model. One exact per-action conjunction rule replaces the full prioritized rule engine. Lower-ranked pairs are audit-only in the gate; the deliberately unsafe baseline promotes them and omits object checks. Not an upstream benchmark or baseline reproduction.
